title: Right-Aligned Triangle
description:
Print a right-aligned triangle of 4 rows. Each row is padded with spaces so the stars align to the right.

**Expected output:**
```
   *
  **
 ***
****
```
starterCode:
# Print a right-aligned triangle
# Row 1: 3 spaces + 1 star
# Row 2: 2 spaces + 2 stars
# Row 3: 1 space + 3 stars
# Row 4: 0 spaces + 4 stars
hint: Each row has (4 - row_number) spaces followed by row_number stars. Use string multiplication: " " * 3 + "*" * 1 for the first row.
